title: The Lamp-Oil Line
request: Trace the lamp-oil spend through the months on one line, and give me back the months in calendar order with their spend. The clerk filed the slips in whatever order they fell.
objective: Order a table by its x column before plotting a line and deliver the ordered series.
hints: A line drawn through shuffled slips wanders backwards in time even when every point is right.
sort the month column upward first; plot takes the x column and then the measured column.
Name the calendar-ordered table, plot that table, and deliver the same ordered table rather than the cart you were handed.
inputCode:
import random
from datascience import Table, make_array
months = random.sample(range(1, 13), random.randint(4, 8))
oil = [random.randrange(4, 60, 2) for _ in months]
shelf = Table().with_columns('month', make_array(*months), 'oil', make_array(*oil))
